integrity: The theorem is proved analytically. Exact cyclotomic computations are used only to check explicit witnesses and the finite Möbius-permutation lemma; they are not substituted for the all-dimensional proof.
scientific_limitations: Specific to affine parallelogram supports over \(\mathbb F_5^d\); arbitrary four-point supports and other primes are not classified. Literature searches cannot exclude an equivalent formulation hidden in specialized rank-deficient Fourier-minor or cyclotomic literature.
title: Exact Fourier-support spectrum for four-point affine parallelograms over \(\mathbb F_5^d\)
